caption:
Rizq and work: Allah made the earth easy for you.

Allah tells us He made the earth smooth for us, so we can travel through its regions and eat from His provisions, and that to Him we will all return. Start this Wednesday's work knowing where your provision really comes from.

Surah Al-Mulk 67:15

Before you open your laptop, ask Allah to bless what you earn.
